articles.text: ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Qǐngwèn, dào Xīméndīng qù, zuò jǐlù chē?
MR. ANDERSON: May I ask, what bus do you take to get to Xīméndīng?
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Shíbālù chē duō bu duō?
MR. ANDERSON: Are there many Number 18 buses?
LÙRÉN: Bù shǎo. Měi gé èrshifēn zhōng yǒu yìbān.
PASSERBY: Quite a few. There's one every twenty minutes.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Zuìhòu yìbān chē shi jǐdiǎn zhōng?
MR. ANDERSON: What time is the last bus?
LÙRÉN: Shíyīdiǎn shífēn. Zhèibān chē shi qù Xīméndīng. Shàng chē ba!
PASSERBY: Eleven-ten. This bus goes to Xīméndīng. Get on!
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Dào Xīméndīngde shíhou, qǐng gàosu wo.
MR. ANDERSON: When we get to Xīméndīng, please tell me.
LÙRÉN: Hǎo. Xià yízhàn jiù shi Xīméndīng.
PASSERBY: Okay. The next stop is Xīméndīng.
